shared_elements: low-relief carving on an upright rounded-topped slab
register-like horizontal division of the surface
a row of repeated small motifs forming a band
figures with raised or extended arms
justification: Both are upright, rounded-topped slabs carved in low relief and divided into horizontal registers, with animals in profile and a band of repeated small motifs across the upper area, which gives a similar overall silhouette and layered impression. But the depicted content differs sharply: A shows a winged disc, bands of script-like signs and multiple seated/standing human figures in offering-like interaction, while B shows crouching quadrupeds, a bird, a large snake-like or reptilian form and animal heads in high relief with no human scenes or writing.
